verdict.rationale: LangSmith is an observability and evaluation SaaS platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. A probe confirms an official, first-party MCP server is documented under the langchain-ai GitHub org (langsmith-mcp-server), which delivers the core of the story. However, the evidence is a single pointer with no detail on what the server exposes or how to connect to it. Missing for 10: documentation of the exposed tools and capabilities (e.g., trace or dataset access), setup and auth instructions for connecting an agent, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
